notes: बताना (to tell) is how Hindi asks for a recommendation: कोई अच्छा रेस्टोरेंट बता सकते हैं? ("can you tell me a good restaurant?").
खाकर देखिए ("eat and see") means "try it". The same pattern works for other verbs: पहनकर देखिए (try it on).
काफ़ी means "quite" or "enough": काफ़ी सस्ता, quite cheap.
Many famous places to eat are small stalls in old markets, like the paratha lanes of Old Delhi.
